# ELEC3 portfolio — full project briefs

Companion to https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/llms.txt
Primary portfolio: https://www.marksiazon.dev

---

## Ass#1: Spring Boot RESTful Web Services

Developed a comprehensive User Management REST API using Spring Boot and MySQL.
The project implements a standard layered architecture (Controller, Service, Repository) to handle CRUD operations for user data.

Key Features:
- Database configuration with Hibernate.
- Entity modeling.
- API testing using Postman.

Tags: Java SpringBoot, REST API, MySQL, Postman
PDF: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/files/Project-Ass-1.pdf

---

## Ass#2: AWS Deployment Guide

A step-by-step guide for deploying a simple website on AWS, mirroring real-world cloud practices.
Demonstrates EC2 (t3.micro), S3 static hosting, RDS MySQL, and Security Groups for HTTP/HTTPS/SSH.

Tags: AWS, EC2, S3, RDS, Cloud Hosting
PDF: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/files/Project-Ass-2.pdf

---

## Ass#3: Intro to Docker & Containerization

Two-week curriculum: Docker foundations, multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, and a milestone full-stack container project.

Tags: Docker, Containerization, DevOps, Learning Plan
PDF: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/files/Project-Ass-3.pdf

## Lab Activity: Docker Image Deployment

## Ass#4: Virtualization vs. Containerization

Research narrative on VMs vs Docker at the edge; efficiency findings for short jobs, long-running services, and ARM edge deployments.

Tags: Research, Virtualization, Docker, Edge Computing
PDF: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/files/Project-Ass-4.pdf

## Ass#6: Terraform Survivor

IaC-controlled browser survival game; Terraform generates config.js; GitHub Actions deploys to Pages.

GitHub: https://github.com/mark-siazon/AE3-Terraform_Survivor
